findings.text: the landing record names wholly-hit helper programs jit__argmin, jit__argmax and jit__broadcast_arrays, but the CACHE_GUARD_RECEIPT it cites shows those three with zero hits (jit__argmax 0 hits and 2 misses, jit__broadcast_arrays 0 hits and 13 misses, jit__argmin absent from the 68 program profiles) while the programs that did hit are a different set (empty 1146, jit_scan 6, jit_iota 2, jit_less 2, jit_broadcast_in_dim 1, jit_split_flux_map 1); the clause that the lane's own solve programs are exactly the ones the pin does not carry understates a receipt in which 62 of 68 program profiles are miss-only.

the negative-control log's command line still carries a literal placeholder in place of the interpreter path while the green log regenerated at 958f5722b names the real interpreter and revision, so the declared gate pair differs in provenance.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against b1a3664b5: 958f5722b adds the PREWARM_ROW_NO_PROGRAMS refusal and its paired test plus a run.sh --gres change, 30f9ae4e4 retracts the sbatch --test-only queue claim, and 89fe2174d records the negative lane receipt in the plan section and the landing record.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for one lane run reporting hits and zero compile seconds, and the gate measuring the guard half is tests/test_h200_cache_guard.py; its log records 5 passed in 46.50s at revision 958f5722b, and the lane run is recorded as a miss, so the objective half is recorded unmet rather than claimed met.
item_verdicts.goal: the reviewed node's goal is a pre-warm pin that covers the lane's own programs and is read by the lane with zero compile seconds; the three commits add a correct compile-row refusal and record the real lane run, but no pin rebuilt at the serving revision exists, so the section's pin-covers-the-lane outcome stays open.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it lists the five commits with bodies and no attribution trailer, states the five-case gate green, declares the served_entries negative control reproduced as assert 7 == 3, and repeats the landing record's helper-program claim on its measurement reason line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every file in the three commits' diff (scripts/h200_test_lane/prewarm_row.py, scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh, tests/test_h200_cache_guard.py, the plan and the cumulative landing record) sits inside them and no nova/ file is touched.

justifications.durability: tests/test_h200_cache_guard.py:100 drives the refusal red on an idle target and green on the same row without --compile-row, an assertion independent of the value under test, though no test covers an already-warm compile row passing.
justifications.evidence: docs/evidence/archive/forward-solver-route-integrity-landed.html:1236 carries the headline receipt numbers I re-read in the CACHE_GUARD_RECEIPT line, but line 1248 states a comparison that same receipt contradicts.
justifications.fit: scripts/h200_test_lane/prewarm_row.py:124 reuses the existing PREWARM_ROW vocabulary and row and receipt idiom and adds no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/h200_test_lane/prewarm_row.py:122 adds the refusal the guard half of the goal needs, but no pin rebuilt at the serving revision exists, so the section's central outcome remains open.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff changes only scripts/h200_test_lane/prewarm_row.py, scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh, tests/test_h200_cache_guard.py and the two nova docs, all inside the declared scope.
